entities.summary: Annelies Verbeke is a Belgian author who writes in Dutch. She made her name with the novel Slaap! (Sleep!) which has been translated into several languages. Annelies Verbeke was a poets & playwrights from Londerzeel (b. 1976-02-06, Londerzeel). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
